result.topic_en: Historical notes on the vibrating-string problem: the wave equation, d'Alembert's general solution y = f(x+at) + g(x-at) (1747), the boundary conditions at the fixed ends, and Euler's subsequent treatment (1748) with arbitrary initial form and velocity.
